originals.why: Here syniad is part of the idiom 'doedd gen i ddim syniad' ('I had no idea'), not 'idea' in the sense this LEGO teaches. Natural Korean can't use the 아이디어 gloss, and the Korean could equally be answered with 'doeddwn i ddim yn gwybod', so it breaks the one-answer rule.
